info.name: Mental Health Clinic API - Patients (Clinical Data + CRN)
info.description:
Patient endpoints with the clinical dataset (staging, treatment, tumour biology, BMI, comorbidities, drugs) and the unique CRN file number.

Reuses environment variables: baseUrl, accessToken (an ADMIN/CALL_CENTER token for create/full edit), doctorToken (a DOCTOR token for clinical-only edit), patientId.
Adds: crn (auto-captured on create).

All routes are mounted under {{baseUrl}}/api/v1.

RBAC summary:
- POST /patients: ADMIN, CALL_CENTER (sets crn + demographics).
- PATCH /patients/:id: ADMIN/CALL_CENTER (all fields); DOCTOR (clinical fields + medicalHistory only — any other field => 403).
- Volunteers see basic identity/contact info only; clinical list filters are ignored for them.

request.description:
Creates a User (role PATIENT) + Patient row atomically. `crn` is required and unique. Roles: ADMIN, CALL_CENTER.

Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; 403 FORBIDDEN; 409 CONFLICT (`Email already registered` or `CRN already in use`).
Roles: ADMIN, DOCTOR, CALL_CENTER, VOLUNTEER. `q` also matches CRN. Each row carries `latestAssessments` (DOCTOR/ADMIN only). Volunteers receive basic identity/contact fields only.
Filter the patient list by typed clinical fields. NOTE: these filters are silently IGNORED for VOLUNTEER callers (to avoid leaking clinical data they cannot see).
Roles: ADMIN, DOCTOR, CALL_CENTER, VOLUNTEER, PATIENT (own record only). Response is shaped by role — volunteers get basic identity/contact info only.
Minimal active-patient lookup ({id, fullName}). Roles: ADMIN, DOCTOR.
ADMIN/CALL_CENTER may edit any field. Scalar `null` clears a field; JSONB sub-key `null` removes that sub-key (shallow merge). Errors: 400; 403; 404; 409 (`CRN already in use`).
Uses {{doctorToken}}. A DOCTOR may edit only clinical fields + medicalHistory. Including any other field (e.g. crn, phone, address, socialStatus, financials) => 403 FORBIDDEN and nothing is applied.
Expected 403 FORBIDDEN — `address` is not a clinical field, so a DOCTOR cannot edit it.
Merged assessments (Postgres) + interventions (Mongo), newest first. Roles: ADMIN, DOCTOR. `page * pageSize` <= 1000.
